wiring: lib/judged-rails.ts (ADR 0017), enforced from the start (ADR 0021): the turn-end evidence obligation and the merge rail; yes leaves the obligation unmet and refuses the merge; a judge failure does the same

score_provenance.run: omp 19.0.1 library judge (Settings overlay modelRoles.judge typesafe/jev-1.14.0, retry.fallbackChains.judge []; TYPESAFE_API_KEY from Infisical dev via infisical run), one judge() call per case, retries 2, concurrency 8, 2026-11-21; every answer reported model typesafe/jev-1.14.0
score_provenance.call: judge({state, questions}) per case through resolveJudge (omp judge role), questions.json questions
score_provenance.cost_note: unknown: the library judge() reports no usage; the earlier omp -p batch of the same 92 cases cost $0.00487
score_provenance.rescore: all 92 cases re-scored 2026-11-21 after the owner ruling; labels changed for CE029 only; scores moved by at most 0.14 (64 of 92 moved)

baseline.value: none: completion claims are not checked today

costs.value: a miss (unsupported completion accepted) costs more than a false action (owner review)

framing.written_policy: label-guide.md rules E1-E9; deterministic pre-check P1-P10 runs first

minimums.reason: jev-actions defaults; recall raised to 0.9 because a miss costs more

evidence_gap.cost_rule: miss costs more: the cost-rule threshold 0.3 was not adopted; the threshold is the former band's yes side (ADR 0021)

measured_band.note: measurement record only: without a fallback judge a band cannot decide (ADR 0021)
measured_band.between: escalate to the owner (fallback judge: a person)
measured_band.rule: pass_below: largest dev cut with zero positives below it; flag_at_or_above: smallest dev cut with flagged precision >= 0.8 (at least 5 flagged)
measured_band.fallback_assumption: cascade recall assumes the person resolves every escalated case as the arbitrated label

results.tuning: tune_threshold.py --min-precision 0.8 --min-recall 0.9 --beta 2 --conservative --repeats 5: 0 of 25 folds qualified; no threshold meets minimums (non-conservative run: also none). Zero-minimum run (information only, gates nothing): best F2 threshold 0.625, folds 0.365-0.805, test P 0.43 R 1.00
results.calibration: Brier raw 0.2994 dev, Platt held-out 0.1705; test raw 0.3467, Platt 0.1644. Platt (a 0.8184, b -1.6125, fitted on all dev) accepted for any read of the probability; thresholds and band stay in raw space. Reliability bins not checked: do not show as confidence
results.errors: raw scores sit high on negatives; top dev false positives after the owner ruling: CE038 0.98, CE029 0.96, CE030 0.96, CE012 0.89, CE062 0.89. CE029, CE030 and CE038 are skill or runbook doc changes the ruling labels 0 (E4); Jev still treats them as behaviour. CE062 is a code change (scout association lane) with E3 evidence, not a docs case

label_set.units: 82 PRs (unit = owner/repo#number); dev/test split by FNV-1a hash of unit (70/30), no unit in both

sources.adversarial_note: request of one PR paired with the evidence of another in the same repository; unit = the request PR

label_set.provenance: agent_reviewed: innovation-council first pass via omp -p (council plus innovation-challenger and experiment-peer labelling independently, then council adjudication), blind to jev scores; claude arbitrated after reading every split case, before scoring. 82 of 92 unanimous; 10 challenger/peer splits; arbiter overruled 1 (CE089 0 -> 1). Owner may override with human rows
label_set.precheck_excluded: 11 of 295 PRs with request and evidence sections failed P5-P7 (no or failing checks) and were not sampled
label_set.selection: per-repository quotas from 284 eligible merged or closed PRs in 8 adam-jackson-cf repositories; half of each quota from PRs with a Not tested paragraph, the rest by stable hash
label_set.redaction: 2026-11-21: device serials, a tailnet address, a node id, home paths and host names in case states and label notes were pseudonymised (owner/agent home, DEVICESERIALn, 100.64.0.10, nuc-host, nuc, mac-a)
label_set.owner_rulings: 2026-11-21: skill and runbook docs that steer agents are docs (E4), not behaviour (E5). 14 rows carry provenance 'owner ruling 2026-11-21: docs' (CE007, CE010, CE011, CE012, CE017, CE026, CE029, CE030, CE031, CE033, CE035, CE036, CE038, CE081); CE029 changed 1 -> 0, the other 13 kept their labels

shortfalls: No threshold meets precision 0.8 / recall 0.9 on dev; the shipped threshold is untuned
At the shipped threshold (the former band's flag side) test flagged precision is 0.57 (3 false of 7): false merge refusals are expected until a retune
Dev positives 25 (< about 30); real replay positives only 21 of 31; scout and skills-directory have 0

Framing values (action, baseline, costs, minimums) are assumed; owner to confirm
